What it is: Monthly mean of half-hourly VIC1 price (1)
Why consider it: TWAP is the CF denominator, and the current method uses it

What it is: Mean price of the half-hours below $0
Why consider it: DWAP floors negatives at $0 but TWAP does not, so deeper negatives raise CF

What it is: Mean price of the half-hours at or above $0
Why consider it: Sets the level of the positive prices that make up DWAP
Related to air density and the seasonal cycle
Humid air is less dense, so wind carries slightly less power at the same wind speed
Direct measure of air moisture (unlike RH, it does not change with temperature).
Rainy weather systems such as fronts and storms are often windy.

What it is: Month of the year as a circle (seasonal shape)
Why consider it: Captures the seasonal pattern of prices and generation
